about_short_description.short_description: Qventus provides AI-driven automation solutions to optimize healthcare operations.

product.name: Qventus AI Platform
product.description: A healthcare operations automation platform that combines AI, machine learning, behavioral science, and real-time data to identify operational needs and execute administrative workflows.

product.name: Inpatient Capacity
product.description: An inpatient operations solution that supports early discharge planning, patient-flow coordination, and capacity management to reduce excess hospital days and improve bed availability.

product.name: Surgical Growth
product.description: An AI-enabled surgical operations solution that aligns growth strategies with daily operating-room workflows to improve utilization, case selection, service-line growth, and robotic surgery volume.

product.name: Perioperative Care Coordination
product.description: An AI-based solution for pre-admission testing teams that automates administrative coordination, helps optimize patients for surgery, and reduces avoidable surgical cancellations.

identifier.value: Care Gap and Coding Automation Suite

product.name: Care Gap and Coding Automation Suite
product.description: A healthcare automation suite that identifies care gaps, supports earlier intervention for complex conditions, and helps complete documentation needed for accurate coding and reimbursement.
